rationale: As a manufacturer of large-format inkjet printers for signage, displays, and vehicle wraps, Agfa's product portfolio success depends on the total solution quality their customers can deliver. The VP of Product Management owns product strategy, differentiation, and competitive positioning. They would care deeply about Tedlar because: (1) Agfa can recommend or co-market Tedlar as the premium overlaminate choice alongside their Jeti Tauro, Anapurna Ciervo, and Onset Grizzly printers, creating a complete durability story that enhances their value proposition; (2) Their customers' warranty claims and complaints about print durability reflect back on Agfa's printer performance—partnering with Tedlar (12-20+ year outdoor lifespan, UV protection, graffiti resistance) enables Agfa to deliver documented durability outcomes that protect their brand reputation; (3) Product Management owns customer success metrics and could drive Tedlar into reference architectures, technical specifications, and sales training materials; (4) Given Agfa's premium positioning and presence at FESPA, ISA Sign Expo, and winning 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards, they need premium material partners to maintain market leadership. Tedlar enables Agfa to claim the most durable end-to-end solution in outdoor graphics, supporting higher printer ASPs and customer lifetime value.

Agfa's Technical Services or Applications Engineering team provides technical support to sign manufacturers, print service providers, and vehicle wrap installers using their equipment. This Director owns customer satisfaction, technical troubleshooting, and application development for Agfa's UV-curable and solvent ink systems across outdoor signage, vehicle graphics, and architectural applications. They would care about Tedlar because: (1) Customer complaints about premature fading, cracking, UV degradation, or graffiti damage on outdoor graphics create support burden and escalations—recommending Tedlar as the validated overlaminate eliminates a major source of field failures; (2) Technical Services must develop and publish application guidelines, substrate compatibility matrices, and lamination specifications—establishing Tedlar as the recommended protective film simplifies their technical documentation and training; (3) They manage relationships with key customers who demand proven durability for high-profile installations (transit graphics, building wraps, fleet graphics)—Tedlar's 60+ year track record and -70°F to 230°F operating range provides the technical credibility their largest customers require; (4) This role owns application development KPIs and customer uptime metrics, both improved by reducing rework and warranty exposure through superior overlaminate performance.

Agfa's Sales leadership sells into sign manufacturers, commercial printers, and vehicle wrap companies globally—the same companies that are direct purchasers of Tedlar protective films. The VP of Sales would care about Tedlar as a strategic partnership opportunity because: (1) Sales teams can close higher-value printer deals by offering a complete durability solution—'Agfa printers + Tedlar overlaminate = guaranteed 15+ year outdoor performance'—addressing the #1 customer concern about outdoor graphics longevity; (2) In competitive situations against HP, Canon, Epson (competitors seen at FESPA), a validated Tedlar partnership differentiates Agfa's solution and justifies premium pricing; (3) Sales owns customer acquisition and retention metrics—co-marketing programs, joint case studies, and technical webinars with Tedlar provide lead generation tools and strengthen customer relationships; (4) With Agfa operating in 40+ countries through wholly owned sales organizations, a Tedlar partnership enables consistent global messaging about durability and premium positioning; (5) Large fleet graphics and transit customers demand long warranty periods—Tedlar's extreme durability (no yellowing, fading, cracking) enables Sales to confidently commit to extended performance guarantees that close enterprise deals.
